rejected_rule.statement: The Court of Appeal may not receive and admit new evidence in an appeal from a High Court exercising supervisory jurisdiction, except as provided in Section 11(3) of the High Courts of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act No. 19 of 1990.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: The Court of Appeal could admit new evidence under Section 11 (3) of the Act No 19 of 1990 only in "addition to or supplimentary of the evidence already taken in any High Court".
